stem.text: A long tube, filled with water, has a tap fitted at its base, as shown.
A tuning fork is sounded above the tube and the water is allowed to run gradually out of the tube.

stem.alt: Diagram of a tuning fork above an open-topped tube filled with water, with a tap at the base of the tube; labels tuning fork, tube, water and tap.

stem.text: A louder sound is heard at intervals as the water runs out of the tube. The change in water level between louder sounds is $32\,\text{cm}$.
What is the wavelength of the sound in the tube?
